name: Heli
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament

points: And Jesus himself began to be about thirty years of age, being (as was supposed) the son of Joseph, which was the son of Heli. So when Christ started teaching he was thirty years of age. It was not by accident — that was the age when the priesthood started.

note.label: When Children Walk in a Land of Shadows (Part 2)

points: Jesus, being as was supposed the son of Joseph, which was the son of Heli; everyone knew whose son he was.

Joseph is written as Heli's son because Heli had no sons and Joseph inherited his land as his son-in-law, exactly as Tobias stood in Raguel's record; his biological father is Jacob in Matthew 1, and both houses are Judah, which is why he could inherit both lands.

note.label: The Nativity: the Bloodline, Birthright, & the Messiah

points: Jesus began to be about thirty years of age, being, as was supposed, the son of Joseph, which was the son of Heli. Heli was the father of Mary, so this line is reckoned through the son-in-law.

note.label: Luke 3: The Preaching of John and the Generations Back to Adam
